content.title: What stores are closed on Easter? Is Target, Walmart, Costco open?
content.text: April 3, 2026, 8:58 a.m. ETEaster is generally a time for family gatherings and wonderful meals celebrating a holiday.However, what happens when something is forgotten or you need a unique spice? Unlike Christmas, there are stores open on Easter Sunday.When is Easter 2026?Easter is April 5, 2026.Why is Easter a floating holiday?The holiday date is determined by the first Sunday after the first full moon after the spring equinox, which is March 20. The Paschal full moon occurred on April 1, making Easter April 5.What stores are open and closed on Easter?Several stores may change their hours for the holiday, so it's best to call before making a trip.Is Target open on Easter?No, Target stores will be closed on Easter Sunday this year.Is Walmart open on Easter?Yes, Walmart will be open regular hours on Easter.Are Costco or Sam's Club open on Easter?No, both Costco and Sam's Club warehouses will be closed on April 5.Is BJ's Wholesale Club open on Easter?A majority of BJ's stores are to be open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday.Some club hours may vary slightly – members can check with their local club.Is ACME open on Easter?A majority of Albertson's banner stores are to be open on Easter. Those stores include ACME, Safeway, Albertsons, Jewel-Osco, Vons and Tom Thumb. Some may be operating with reduced hours on the holiday.Is Whole Foods open on Easter?Whole Foods stores will be to open on Easter but might have reduced hours.Customers can use the company's store locator tool to confirm their additional store hours.Is Wegmans open on Easter?Yes, Wegmans stores are to be open during regular hours on Easter.Is Weis open on Easter?Yes, Weis stores are to be open from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Easter.Is Aldi open on Easter?No, Aldi stores are to be closed on April 5.Is CVS open on Easter?Yes, CVS Pharmacy locations are to be open on Easter, although some stores may have reduced hours. It's recommended that customers call their local store before visiting or check hours at cvs.com. Is Walgreens open on Easter?Yes, Walgreens store and pharmacy locations are to be open for regular hours on Easter. Customers should check the store locator to determine the hours of their local store.Is Rite Aid open on Easter?Rite Aid stores are to be open on Easter, but the pharmacies might be closed. Customers should check their website for exact store hours.Is Dollar General open on Easter?Yes, Dollar General stores are to be open with normal hours on Easter. Hours can vary by location and are available at dg.com or within the DG app.Is Lowe's open on Easter?No, all Lowe's stores will be closed on the holiday.Is Home Depot open on Easter?Yes, Home Depot stores will be open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter.Is Ace Hardware open on Easter?Ace Hardware stores are independently owned and operated, so hours vary by location. Customers are encouraged to contact their local store to confirm business hours on Easter.Is Macy's open on Easter?No, Macy's stores will be closed on April 5.Is Nordstrom open on Easter?All Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack stores will be closed on Easter this year.Is JCPenney open on Easter?No, all JCPenney stores will be closed on Easter Sunday.Is Kohl's open on Easter?No, Kohl's stores will be closed on April 5.Are TJ Maxx, Marshall's or HomeGoods open on Easter?No, all three stores will be closed on Easter Sunday.Is Victoria's Secret open on Easter?Most U.S. stores will be closed on Easter; however, some will be open and are subject to their mall's hours of operation.Is Sephora open on Easter?Sephora store hours vary by location and customers are encouraged to use the company's store locator for specific store hours.Are Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic or Athleta open on Easter?Easter hours will vary for each of these stores and customers are encouraged to contact their local stores for specific hours of operation.Is Barnes & Noble open on Easter?Yes, Barnes & Noble stores are open on Easter but hours may vary.Are Bass Pro Shops or Cabela's open on Easter?Yes, both stores are typically open during their regular hours on Easter. However some locations are subject to the hours of their malls or shopping centers so call your local store to verify before making your trip.Is REI open on Easter?No, most REI stores will be closed on Easter Sunday.Is Burlington open on Easter?All Burlington stores will be closed on Easter.Is IKEA open on Easter?Yes, IKEA stores will be open from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter this year.Is Michaels open on Easter?No, Michaels stores are to be closed on Easter.Is Petco open on Easter?Yes, Petco stores will be open regular hours on April 5.Is PetSmart open on Easter?Yes, PetSmart stores will be open from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday.Are Office Depot and OfficeMax open on Easter?All Office Depot and OfficeMax stores will be closed on Easter.Is Tractor Supply Company open on Easter?Hours for Tractor Supply Co. stores on Easter Sunday vary by location. Verify the operating hours with your local store.
